messages.subject: rhmr -> rhwatch (BlueSNP)
parts:
Hi,

BlueSNP is a package for GWAS that depends on Rhipe:
https://github.com/ibm-bioinformatics/BlueSNP

The current version was developed against Rhipe 0.69. I am using 0.73, and it looks like a change was made between these releases deprecating rhmr or changing its supported syntax.

> test.installation()
[BlueSNP] Reusing existing Rhipe connection
Copying simulated_cc.tped to HDFS bluesnp_test/simulated_cc.tped
Copying simulated_cc.tfam to HDFS bluesnp_test/simulated_cc.tfam
Parsing tped file into SNP records
[BlueSNP] Reusing existing Rhipe connection
Error in rhmr(jobname = jobname, map = map, reduce = reduce, inout = inout,  : 
  STOP! Do not call rhmr, call rhwatch with the same arguments you would have done with rhmr

The error is pretty clear, that he should replace rhmr calls with rhwatch.

However, I am wondering if there is a way to fix this on the BlueSNP side that would be both forwards- and backwards- compatible with Rhipe 0.72+ as well as 0.69?
Or will this require forking a new version of BlueSNP (with rhmr->rhwatch change) to support only Rhipe versions 0.72 and later.

thanks
slaton

messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Re: rhmr -> rhwatch (BlueSNP)
parts:
Hmm,
I had no idea projects were using Rhipe this much. I changed without worrying about compatibility issues
but more with an idea of streamlining the interface.

rhwatch is available in 0.69 and does something slightly different.
I could help you in converting your command to work with 0.72

You can however modify the command like this

if( as.numeric(rhoptions()$version) ) >= 0.72)
  command is rhwatch(map=map,...)
else
  command is {
    z=rhmr(...)
    result = rhwatch(z,...
}

But the you pasted code appears wrong. Ifolder should be input. Ofolder should be output.
Looking the github link, it should be not ifolder nor ofolder but

input = rhfmt(tped.hdfs.path, type='text'), output=output.hdfs.path

in general, if input="string", then the input is sequence. if output="string", the output is sequence.
for text input, see above (e.g. rhfmt...), for text output: output=rhfmt(path-to-output,type='text')

In the absence of much need documentation, (i assure is going to happen), see rhoptions()$ioformats$text
feel free to ask what the arguments mean.

So your code should now bw

z = rhwatch(
    jobname=jobname,
    map=map,
    reduce=reduce,

input=rhfmt(ifolder,type='text'),
    output=ofolder,

read=FALSE,
    mapred=list(
      mapred.reduce.tasks=mapred.reduce.tasks,
      mapred.task.timeout=ONEMIN*minutes.until.timeout
    )
  )

Thanks
Saptarshi
